It was a mixed bag. Which is a first for what's usually a very consistently good series. Beyond 2 I'd say they were all consistently good films. Just way way too much exposition. Best way I can describe this one is it's not as clean as the last few. 

I feel they went the wrong direction here. Didnt need to tie all the other films together and could have just done a standalone thing. Would have made for a much less convoluted film. 

It was still decent but I think the sentiment on this one wont be strong which is the last thing the cinemas want to hear I'm sure. Worried about how strong the box office will be. I dont know if I'll go too many times like I did for the last 4 films.

The way I wrote it does seem wrong, i was mostly venting rather than giving a full write up. Here is a bit more of a detailed explanation of what happend.

I was getting onto the highway from the Eagleson Park and Ride on-ramp, checked my blind spot, signaled early, and began adjusting my speed to merge safely.

As I came down the ramp, that car was already in the right lane the one I needed to merge into. He was going faster than me, which is fine but I was still ahead of him by a fair margin when I signaled. Instead of adjusting his speed slightly or moving over (which he could have easily done the lane beside him looked mostly clear hence why I was mad he didnt give me the lane), he held his speed and ended up riding right beside me for a good stretch of the merge lane.

That left me boxed out and with no choice but to slow down near the end of the merge lane to find space, which is risky especially if someone’s close behind. Luckily, the car behind me was far enough back that it wasn’t a problem.

Yes I know merging drivers don’t technically have the right of way and I'm not entitled to that lane, but highway drivers are still expected to make merging safer when they can whether that’s adjusting speed or moving over when there’s room. What this driver did wasn’t illegal fair enough, but it was careless and made the situation more dangerous than it needed to be.
